# libretro.h

The libretro API header, from
[libretro-common](https://github.com/libretro/libretro-common) at commit
`ae22debd425c33fe355ac2e51d9a140d7e8b3fa6` (`include/libretro.h`). It's under
the MIT license in its header comment.

`mise run session:bindings` regenerates `src/ffi/generated.rs` from it.
